title: calamagrostis tenella var. alpina
intro: Calamagrostis tenella var. alpina, commonly known as Mountain Fescue, is a type of grass native to the mountainous regions of Europe. It is valued for its potential health benefits, including its ability to reduce inflammation and improve respiratory function, making it a popular ingredient in traditional herbal remedies. The therapeutic actions of Mountain Fescue are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, phenolic acids, and sesquiterpenes, which may help to soothe and calm the body. While research on this plant is limited, its bioactive constituents suggest potential applications in the treatment of various health conditions, including anxiety and insomnia.
